understanding: Cover single-instance cross of Modem Status IIR 000 from CTS DSR RI DCD with concurrent serial traffic states idle tx_active rx_active tx_rx_active plus no_modem traffic sampled on IIR indication on clock edges during data flow
preconditions: Clock drives wb_clk_i and reset drives wb_rst_i to released state with symbolic polarity; wishbone_slave_interface owns wb_adr_i wb_dat_i wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_sel_i and uart_serial_data owns srx_pad_i and modem_control_if owns cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i [f_modem_pads_1]
LCR DLAB 0 for normal access with IER at address 1 and IIR at 2 and MSR at 6 accessible and divisor alias at 0-1 not selected [f_ier_addr_1] [f_iir_addr_1] [f_msr_addr_1] [f_dlab_gate_1]
IER bit3 Modem Status enabled to allow modem interrupt generation with serial link to external modem peer active [f_ier_ms_1] [f_serial_link_1]
stimulus_steps: STAGE0_BRINGUP: wishbone_slave_interface writes SYM_IER with modem enable 1 and reads back; uart_serial_data holds idle; modem_control_if drives symbolic inactive; WAIT drain then SAMPLE IIR baseline [f_ier_ms_1] [f_iir_pending_1]

STAGE1_IDLE_MODEM: modem_control_if toggles one of CTS DSR RI DCD while uart_serial_data holds idle with no TX RX frames; wishbone_slave_interface observes IIR pending 0 and reads MSR to clear [f_modem_src_1] [f_iir_pending_1] [f_msr_addr_1]

STAGE2_TX_MODEM: uart_serial_data starts TX frames via THR path CONCURRENTLY with modem_control_if toggling modem input; wishbone_slave_interface observes IIR and MSR during TX active [f_serial_link_1] [f_modem_src_1]

STAGE3_RX_MODEM: uart_serial_data drives RX frames on srx_pad_i CONCURRENTLY with modem_control_if toggling modem input; wishbone_slave_interface observes IIR and MSR during RX active [f_serial_link_1] [f_modem_src_1]

STAGE4_TXRX_MODEM: uart_serial_data runs simultaneous TX and RX frames CONCURRENTLY with modem_control_if toggling modem input; wishbone_slave_interface observes IIR and MSR during combined activity [f_serial_link_1] [f_modem_src_1]

STAGE5_TRAFFIC_NOMODEM: uart_serial_data runs TX RX and TX_RX traffic with modem inputs held symbolic inactive and no MSR delta; wishbone_slave_interface observes IIR for no_modem_X_traffic [f_iir_pending_1]
FOR each modem source in CTS DSR RI DCD REPEAT STAGE1 through STAGE4 at least once; cleanup restores symbolic inactive and wishbone bus idle
check_steps: COMPARE sampled IIR pending flag equals 0 when claiming modem_000 cross bin and equals 1 for idle no-interrupt baseline [f_iir_pending_1]
COMPARE sampled IIR fixed bits 6_7 equal 1 and bits 5_4 equal 0 when qualifying modem 000 indication [f_iir_fixed_1]
coverage_steps: SAMPLE on CLK edges on Modem Status IIR indication via wishbone_slave_interface monitor plus concurrent tx_active rx_active flags via uart_serial_data monitor and modem_000 versus no_modem via modem_control_if monitor [f_iir_addr_1] [f_serial_link_1] [f_modem_pads_1] [f_modem_src_1]
COMPARE sampled tuple to bins modem_000_X_idle and modem_000_X_tx_active and modem_000_X_rx_active and modem_000_X_tx_rx_active and no_modem_X_traffic with per-instance false single UART
SAMPLE with dedicated subscriber tapping monitor analysis ports only; drivers never supply actual results or coverage events
completion: Done when bins modem_000_X_idle and modem_000_X_tx_active and modem_000_X_rx_active and modem_000_X_tx_rx_active and no_modem_X_traffic each hit at least once
Bound by TESTBENCH drain_cycles and request_timeout_cycles operational limits which are testbench limits not DUT timing
Cleanup returns wishbone_slave_interface to idle and srx_pad_i plus cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i to symbolic inactive for handoff

facts.statement: Modem Status interrupt source is CTS DSR RI or DCD cleared by reading Modem Status Register
facts.quote:
0 0 0 4 th Modem Status CTS, DSR, RI or DCD. Reading the Modem
status register.

facts.statement: IIR bit0 0 means interrupt pending and 1 means no interrupt pending
facts.quote:
Bit 0 indicates that an interrupt is pending when it’s logic ‘0’. When it’s ‘1’ – no interrupt
is pending.

facts.statement: IIR bits 4-5 are 0 and bits 6-7 are 1
facts.quote:
Bits 4 and 5: Logic ‘0’.
Bits 6 and 7: Logic ‘1’ for compatibility reason.

facts.statement: IER bit3 Modem Status 0 disabled 1 enabled
facts.quote:
3 RW Modem Status Interrupt
 ‘0’ – disabled
 ‘1’ – enabled

facts.statement: Interrupt Enable register at address 1 enables or masks interrupts
facts.quote:
Interrupt Enable 1 8 RW Enable/Mask interrupts
generated by the UART

facts.statement: Interrupt Identification register at address 2 gets interrupt information
facts.quote: Interrupt Identification 2 8 R Get interrupt information

facts.statement: Modem Status register at address 6 reports modem status
Divisor access when LCR bit7 DLAB is 1 blocks addresses 0-1 normal registers
facts.quote:
The registers can be accessed when the 7th (DLAB) bit of the Line Control Register is set
to ‘1’. At this time the above registers at addresses 0-1 can’t be accessed.

facts.statement: UART provides serial communication with modem or external device over serial cable RS232
facts.quote:
The UART (Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter) core provides serial
communication capabilities, which allow communication with modem or other external
devices, like another computer using a serial cable and RS232 protocol.

facts.statement: Core uses 2 serial pads plus optionally six modem control signals
facts.quote:
It requires 2 pads in the chip (serial in and serial out) and, optionally, another six modem
control signals, which can otherwise be implemented using general purpose I/Os on the
chip.
